claims.text: Controlled Cr and Ta additions to an Al- and Cr-containing NbTi-based lightweight HEA promote in situ formation of a continuous CrTaO4-based oxide scale.
A continuous CrTaO4-based scale acts as a barrier to oxygen and corrosive species.
Formation of the CrTaO4-based scale enables low density, high mechanical strength, corrosion resistance, and oxidation resistance to be combined in the alloy.
Tailored heat treatment and oxidation exposure stimulate formation of a continuous, adherent CrTaO4-based scale in the Cr/Ta-modified alloy.
The protective oxide layer may contain dispersed Al2O3 and Cr2O3 in addition to CrTaO4.
Formation of the proposed oxide scale leaves the alloy's bulk microstructure unaltered.
The CrTaO4 scale impedes oxygen ingress and thereby reduces high-temperature oxidation weight gain.
The CrTaO4 scale impedes ingress of corrosive species and thereby reduces corrosion.
The modified alloy's bulk remains low-density and mechanically robust after Cr and Ta alloying and oxide-scale formation.
Mechanical integrity of the oxide/alloy interface under cyclic loading is necessary for the scale's protective effect.
Relative to the baseline, the Cr/Ta-modified alloy will have substantially lower oxidation weight gain during exposure at 1000–1100 °C for up to 200 hours.
Relative to the baseline, the Cr/Ta-modified alloy will have lower corrosion current density.
The Cr/Ta-modified alloy will maintain its mechanical strength under cyclic loading.
If the CrTaO4 scale is discontinuous or degrades under cyclic loading, the modified alloy's performance will be similar to that of the baseline.
Processing variations or extreme thermal or mechanical cycling can prevent protective-scale formation or cause spallation or porous oxide formation.

contradictions.description: The baseline is described as already containing Cr, but elsewhere the comparison is described as an alloy with added Cr/Ta versus a baseline 'without them.' This makes it unclear whether the control lacks Cr entirely, lacks only Ta, or contains a lower/background Cr concentration.
